answer:
Use **Workflows**. The concepts doc describes them this way: "A Workflow in LlamaIndex is a specific event-driven abstraction that allows you to orchestrate a sequence of steps and LLMs calls." ["llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/getting_started/concepts.md"]

The agent docs say you can "build your own agentic workflows from scratch" in the "Building Workflows" section ["llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/understanding/agent/index.md"]. The understanding guide also notes that workflows can maintain state and can be traced and debugged with integrations like Arize Phoenix and OpenTelemetry ["llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/understanding/index.md"].

The context doesn't include code examples for defining workflow steps or events, so check the Workflows guide for those details.
